title: PbfuzzMetrics
description: `.pbfuzz/<id>/state/metrics.json` — written ONLY by the Python engine, never by the agent. The native guard (`core/guard-policy.ts::decide()`) denies any `write`/`edit` targeting this path, and the bash tamper ledger records shell attempts to touch it. That separation is what makes the metrics trustworthy evidence for REFLECT: the model cannot report progress it did not make.

total_reached_count.description: Cumulative reaching executions across every round.

last_reached_count.description: Reaching executions in the most recent fuzz session — the signal REFLECT compares round over round.

last_session.description: Summary of the most recent `pbfuzz_fuzz` job.

reproduced_times.description: How many times the engine re-ran `first_triggering_input` after the session stopped.

reproduced_ok.description: How many of those re-runs triggered again. This is the PoV's reproduction count; nobody else is in a position to measure it.
